lines.text: Start with any $V$ and an empty list $Returns(s)$ for each state
for each state $s$ that occurs in it:
$G \leftarrow$ the return after the first time $s$ occurs
add $G$ to $Returns(s)$; set $V(s)$ to the average of $Returns(s)$

name: Monte Carlo ES (exploring starts)
inputs: episodes that always end (assumed by the draft)

lines.text: Start with any $Q(s, a)$, any $\pi(s)$ and empty lists $Returns(s, a)$
pick a start pair $(S_0, A_0)$, every pair having positive probability
generate an episode from $(S_0, A_0)$, then follow $\pi$
for each pair $(s, a)$ in it: average the return after its first occurrence into $Q(s, a)$
for each $s$ in it: $\pi(s) \leftarrow \operatorname{argmax}_a Q(s, a)$
